data.title: A claim starts the work: a claimed task before the started column moves into it
data.why: A claimed task stayed in backlog: the board showed taken work as not started, and the release that claimed KAD-81 moved backlog to done (2026-10-12 note); the site's own demo showed it. Only a claim that holds moves anything, only forward, through the same move the CLI makes. A contested task stays in ready whatever its column, because it needs a person.
data.rejected: Leave the column to the claimant: every agent then has to know a second command, and none of them did; Move contested claims too: a claim you do not hold is not yours to start
